title: Khaemenes Scholarly Publishing Core
description: Higher-learning publishing templates for complete course readings, theorem exposition, proof workshops, mathematical investigations, counterexample work, research, assessments, solutions, and instructor guidance.

templates.title: Course Reading
templates.description: A complete student-facing reading designed to carry essential instruction without requiring an outside textbook.

templates.title: Theorem & Proof Exposition
templates.description: A formal exposition template for theorem statements, proof architecture, dependencies, complete proof, hypothesis audit, and interpretation.

templates.title: Solutions & Mathematical Commentary
templates.description: A solution set that explains strategy, visible reasoning, verification, common errors, and transferable ideas rather than only giving answers.

templates.title: Guided Proof Workshop
templates.description: A learner-centered proof workshop moving from statement decoding and an independent attempt through graduated hints, proof audit, and revision.

templates.title: Mathematical Investigation Laboratory
templates.description: A mathematics-specific laboratory format that separates computation or visualization from proof and requires reproducible mathematical reasoning.

templates.title: Counterexample Studio
templates.description: A structured environment for testing universal claims, searching boundary cases, verifying counterexamples, and repairing false statements.

templates.title: Mathematical Research Brief
templates.description: A compact advanced-mathematics research brief connecting questions, known results, theorem dependencies, sources, examples, counterexamples, and next actions.

templates.title: Scholarly Source Commentary
templates.description: A source-by-source commentary for identifying claims, exact locations, authority, limitations, relationships to other sources, and provenance.

templates.title: Mastery Assessment
templates.description: An authentic mastery assessment combining conceptual precision, construction or computation, proof/counterexample, transfer, error analysis, and defense.

templates.title: Midterm Examination
templates.description: A cumulative midterm structure aligned to conceptual, proof, computational, laboratory, and synthesis evidence.

templates.title: Final Examination
templates.description: A full-course final examination structure emphasizing written proof, computation/construction, laboratory analysis, synthesis, and defense.

templates.title: Instructor / Independent-Learner Guide
templates.description: A dual-purpose guide for instructors and independent learners containing sequence, misconceptions, graduated hints, solution notes, mastery evidence, and accessibility supports.
